title: Şey, yani, falan
goal: Fill pauses and soften with şey, yani, falan and friends, and shade words with -CIk, -CAğIz and -(I)msI.

intro.text: Two friends talk about last night's episode. Listen for the words that carry no news but a lot of feeling: *şey*, *yani*, *falan*, *cidden*. Then make things tiny (*küçücük*), pitiful (*adamcağız*) or only roughly green (*yeşilimsi*).

vocab.en: I mean, that is; so (Yani?: So what?)
and stuff, and so on; about, or so (also filan)
poor, pitiful (zavallı adam: the poor man)

exercises.question: A friend asks about a film, and you need a second to remember its title. Which word fills the pause?

why.1: *Aynen* means **exactly**: it agrees with something just said.
why.2: *Peki* accepts or moves on: **OK, well then**.

exercises.explain: *Şey* (thing) is the Turkish **um**, used while you look for a word.

accept: Seriously? I have never heard of it.
Seriously? I have never heard about it.
Seriously? I have never heard that.
Really? I have never heard of it.
Really? I have never heard about it.
Really? I have never heard that.
[Seriously|Really]? I never heard [of it|about it|that].
[Seriously|Really]? I did not hear [about it|anything] at all.

exercises.text: Çay, kahve ___ içtik, sonra eve döndük.
exercises.en: We had tea, coffee and stuff, then went home.
exercises.explain: *Falan* rounds off a list: **and stuff, and so on**.

accept: Yani bu akşam gelmiyor musun?
Yani bu akşam gelmiyor musunuz?
Yani sen bu akşam gelmiyor musun?
Yani siz bu akşam gelmiyor musunuz?
Bu akşam gelmiyor [musun|musunuz] yani?
Yani bu akşam sen gelmiyor musun?
exercises.explain: *Yani* (so) draws the conclusion; it can also come at the end.

exercises.question: Said flatly, on its own, what does *Yani?* mean?
exercises.explain: *Yani?* on its own asks **So?** or **So what?**
The final k of *küçük* drops before `-CIk`: *küçücük*.

exercises.en: The sea was a greenish colour.

accept: imsi
imtırak

exercises.explain: After a consonant, `-(I)msI` adds its vowel: *yeşil-imsi*. *Yeşilimtırak* means the same.

exercises.prompt: Anyway, let's watch the next episode.
accept: Neyse, sonraki bölümü izleyelim.

context.tr: Yani, şey… izledim ama sonunu pek anlamadım açıkçası.
context.en: Well, um… I watched it, but to be honest I didn't really get the ending.

exercises.question: What do Murat's *yani* and *şey* tell Zeynep?
options: He's hesitating: he isn't sure what to say
exercises.explain: *Yani, şey…* buys time before an answer that isn't quite what Zeynep hoped for.
